name: 6-MAPB
summary: Empathogen drug that is structurally related to 6-APB and MDMA.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It is known to be a serotonin releasing agent and, unlike MDMA, a potent serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist.
pharmacology.kind: Monoamine releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist

uses.text: The drug is not known to have been widely sold as a "designer drug" but has been detected in analytical samples taken from individuals hospitalised after using drug combinations that included other benzofuran derivatives. 6-MAPB was first encountered as a novel designer drug in 2013 and described in the scientific literature in 2014.

summaryZh: 6-MAPB（6-(N-甲基-2-氨丙基)苯並呋喃，英語：6-benzofuran）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C12H15NO，是6-APB與MDMA結構類似物，能作為精神藥物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: Unlike MDMA, it switches on the 5-HT1B receptor strongly. That receptor sits on blood vessels and is the target of the triptan drugs used for migraine.
fact.zh: 與MDMA不同，它會強力活化5-HT1B受體。這個受體分布在血管上，也是治療偏頭痛的翠普登類藥物的作用目標。
fact.zhHans: 与MDMA不同，它会强力活化5-HT1B受体。这个受体分布在血管上，也是治疗偏头痛的翠普登类药物的作用目标。
